ordinal.description: 0-based document order of the FIRST occurrence of this target — the order the harness follows imports in

rawRef.description: The token as authored, @ included and nothing unescaped or cut — what a condition row reports back to an author

target.description: The path the harness resolves: rawRef without its @, its #fragment cut and every `\ ` read as a space. Unique within a blob — a repeated spelling is one import

line.description: 1-based line of the @ in the blob. Exact wherever the enclosing markdown tokens' source text is verbatim; inside a construct marked rewrites before lexing its content (a blockquote's continuation lines, a comment block's residue) it is the line that construct starts on

projection-blob-claude-imports.description: A row of the blob-keyed `blob_claude_imports` table
